## Completed - Strategy Performance Dashboard

### Backend: PerformanceService refactored
- Replaced in-memory Map<TradeRecord> with Prisma queries against Trade table
- GET /api/performance — per-strategy stats (win rate, P&L, profit factor, symbols, avg holding)
- GET /api/performance/summary/full?days=90 — equity curve (daily P&L), monthly breakdown, overall stats
- All data from real closed trades in DB — no mock data

### Frontend: PerformanceLabPage rebuilt
- 5 summary cards: Total P&L, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Closed Trades, Active Strategies
- 30/90/180/365 day toggle buttons
- Per-strategy cards with P&L badges, win rate, trade count, symbol list, bar charts
- Equity curve bar chart (daily cum P&L)
- Monthly breakdown table (trades, wins, losses, win rate, P&L per month)
- Loading skeleton, API offline banner, empty state

### Files changed
- nest/src/modules/performance/performance.service.ts — Prisma rewrite
- nest/src/modules/performance/performance.controller.ts — async endpoints
- src/pages/PerformanceLabPage.jsx — real dashboard (was hardcoded demo)
- src/pages/performance-lab.css — full styling
- src/core/architecture-reference.js — added performance entry
- src/pages/CapabilityMapPage.jsx — added dashboard entry
